info.description:
### 📘 User Service API
Provides identity, authentication, profile management, session lifecycle, two-factor authentication, password recovery, and KYC verification orchestration.
### 🔑 Authentication
Some endpoints require an **Authorization** header:

```http
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

post.description:
Rotates the authenticated user's password and revokes every other session of the user.
The session making the request stays valid, so the caller keeps its access and refresh tokens.
All other devices are signed out and their refresh tokens stop working immediately.

createdAt.description:
CreatedAt is when this login began. It survives token refreshes, which
replace the session row.

lastActivityAt.description:
LastActivityAt is the last token refresh, so it trails the user's real
last request by at most one access-token lifetime.

isExpiredValidationSkip.description:
IsExpiredValidationSkip accepts a token past its expiry. It does not accept
a revoked session: a signed-out, password-rotated or admin-blocked session
is refused whatever this is set to.

codeDelivered.description:
CodeDelivered is false when registration succeeded but the verification code
could not be sent. The account exists and tokenUUID is valid; prompt the user
to resend via POST /api/v1/2fa/otp/resend rather than telling them to check
an inbox that will stay empty.
